description: Retrieves Sentry organizations accessible via the current authentication, with scope varying between user (all in region) and API key (linked org only) credentials.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters to get details for Sentry organizations.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to retrieve next/previous result sets.
cursor.title: Cursor

owner.description: Set to `true` to list only organizations where the authenticated user is an owner.
owner.title: Owner

query.description: Filter results using Sentry's query syntax. Supported fields: `id` (organization ID), `slug` (organization slug), `status` (current status like 'active', 'pending_deletion'), `email` or `member_id` (member's email or ID), `platform` (project platform like 'python'), and `query` (substring match on organization name, slug, member details).
query.title: Query

sortBy.description: Sort results by 'members' (number of members), 'projects' (number of projects), or 'events' (number of events in past 24h), in descending order. Defaults to creation date.
sortBy.title: Sort By

inputSchema.title: GetOrganizationDetailsRequest

name: get_organization_details

GetOrganizationDetailsResponse.description: Response containing details of a Sentry organization.

access.description: List of access scopes available to the current user for this organization.
access.title: Access

allowMemberInvite.description: Whether organization members can invite new members.
allowMemberInvite.title: Allow Member Invite

allowMemberProjectCreation.description: Whether organization members can create new projects.
allowMemberProjectCreation.title: Allow Member Project Creation

allowSuperuserAccess.description: Whether superuser access is allowed for this organization.
allowSuperuserAccess.title: Allow Superuser Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the organization was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

extraOptions.description: Additional configuration options for the organization.
extraOptions.title: Extra Options

features.description: List of enabled feature flags for the organization.
features.title: Features

hasAuthProvider.description: Whether the organization has a configured authentication provider.
hasAuthProvider.title: Has Auth Provider

isEarlyAdopter.description: Whether the organization is enrolled in early adopter features.
isEarlyAdopter.title: Is Early Adopter

onboardingTasks.description: List of onboarding tasks and their completion status.
onboardingTasks.title: Onboarding Tasks

require2FA.description: Whether two-factor authentication is required for all members.
require2FA.title: Require2 Fa

GetOrganizationDetailsResponse.title: GetOrganizationDetailsResponse

completionSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the completion was acknowledged by the user.
completionSeen.title: Completion Seen

data.description: Additional data associated with the task.
data.title: Data

dateCompleted.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was completed.
dateCompleted.title: Date Completed

status.description: Current status of the task (e.g., complete, pending).
status.title: Status

avatarUrl.description: URL to the avatar image, if available.
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the uploaded avatar image, if applicable.
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid

organizationUrl.description: Primary URL for accessing the organization.
organizationUrl.title: Organization Url

regionUrl.description: Regional URL for the organization's data center.
regionUrl.title: Region Url
